description: This file defines the 'Model' class within the OpenCart framework, providing methods for registry interactions such as property access (__get, __set) and existence check (__isset).

classes.name: Model
classes.description: Represents a base model class that interacts with the registry, allowing dynamic property access and management.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the registry property.

methods.name: __get
methods.description: Retrieves a registry item by key; throws an exception if key does not exist.

methods.name: __set
methods.description: Sets a registry item with a specific key and object value.

methods.name: __isset
methods.description: Checks if a registry key exists.
